statement: A failed replica-removal cleanup can no longer strand orphaned DB/WAL files indefinitely: the existing idempotent retry path (reconcileRemovedReplicaCleanup) gains a durable owner — either a cleanup-debt record persisted before terminalizing, and/or a startup filesystem sweep comparing the partitions directory against authoritative rows (the sweep also catches historical orphans) — so the retry becomes reachable; today the coordinator terminalizes on the completion event and nothing ever deletes an orphan. Verified-audit finding 12 (confirmed worse than the audit claimed). doneWhen: the test-receipt probe reads solve/evidence/removed-replica-cleanup-debt-owner.receipt.json with outstanding 0 — cleanup-retry-reachable-after-failure and orphan-files-eventually-deleted receipts passing (deterministic red-on-revert evidence harness).

constraints.statement: Choose and record in a finding: persist a cleanup-debt record before terminalizing, add a startup filesystem sweep, or both. The sweep variant must also catch historical orphans; the debt-record variant alone does not.
Each new regression test must fail when the chosen owner mechanism is reverted (retry unreachable / orphan undeleted) while the rest of the change remains.
